thread:
maya: Heads up — Sales surfaced a customer ask for a formal onboarding + pinning contract for catalog entries. They want SLA-ish guarantees, pin TTL options, and a clear migration path. Anyone around to sketch acceptance gates?
aj: @maya can you paste the customer's bullet asks here? short list is fine.
maya: Sure — copied from the sales note:
  • Tenant-level pin up to 180 days (requested)
  • Rollback / emergency unpin process
  • Bench guarantees: latency p95 threshold, embedding drift threshold, basic quality checks
  • Canary cutover support + migration credits

liam: 180 days is a heavy ops burden. Recommend default 90d TTL and a paid extension for longer pins. Also propose soft-auto-unpin reminder at 30d before expiry.
sanjay: For bench criteria we should be strict but realistic. Proposal: generation p95 <= 150ms on our standard 512-token workload, cost delta <= 1.8x vs baseline, and semantic-sim regression <= 3% on a 200-sample eval set.

kelly: I like the paid-extension idea. From Legal we need a clear clause about performance regressions and our right to require unpin if model fails QA. Also include an audit log (who pinned, reason).
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PROD-3312 — "catalog pinning policy + SLA spec" (assigned: liam)

aj: Rollout plan thoughts: doc + SDK flag support + canary (10 customers) -> GA. Agree on timeline? Q2 sprint 4 seems doable if spec lands soon.

liam: I'll take drafting the spec. Will include benchmarks, rollback playbook, telemetry, and migration incentives (e.g., first 60 days free migration credits). Example bench command to reproduce locally:
```
bench-run --model rwdx-3b --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --samples 200
```
I'll add exact CI steps in the doc.

sanjay: Add monitoring signals: pinned_request_rate, pinned_latency_p95_delta, unpin_rollbacks, eval_fail_rate. Alert thresholds: eval_fail_rate > 2% -> paging.

kelly: Ops/Support ask: include an emergency unpin runbook and standard comm templates for customers. Also add a "pin reason" freeform field in the API for auditability.
aj: UX ask — in Console show pin TTL and expiry countdown + one-click request extension.

liam: Noted. Also adding compatibility matrix: which models support long pins, quantization caveats, fallback behavior (auto-fallback to compatible variant). For fallback semantics: we should default to returning 503 only after attempting compatible fallback; include opt-out flag for strict mode.
maya: Ownership + next steps: liam drafts the spec by EOD Friday, team review Monday standup, legal/ops review ASAP. @deploy-bot can you create a living tracking doc and attach the ticket?
deploy-bot: Tracking doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/catalog-pinning-spec (permissions: product, eng, legal)

aj: One more: migration incentives — recommend 1) 60 days free credits for first migration, 2) migration-runner CLI in console. Add that to the spec.

kelly: I'll draft the legal stub once liam posts the draft. Also confirm data-retention and KMS language for Private deployments.

liam: Will include KMS notes and per-tenant retention defaults. Also adding auto-unpin safety: if we detect sustained quality regression (>3 rounds) we mark pin as suspended and notify customer with remediation steps.
sanjay: Good. Also pre-flight CI: bench + eval + smoke tests must pass before pin acceptance. I'll add a checklist.

maya: Great work — sounds like a plan. Summary: default TTL 90d, paid extensions up to 180d, bench thresholds as discussed, canary 10 tenants, draft by EOD Fri, review Mon.
aj: tiny UI/telemetry nit: include "pin reason" in both audit log and in billing export.

kelly: +1 to billing export.

maya: Closing loop — use this thread as canonical discussion for spec. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
